Fixed: After an Update, dashboard tabs you had open (not only the one you pressed Update in) reload onto the new version; before, they kept running the old one until reloaded by hand, so new things like the browser tab names didn't show there.
The repo list top left no longer shows repos whose folder is gone, e.g. throwaway ones left behind by LFG's own tests.

whats_new.title: Every open tab gets the update
whats_new.text: When you update LFG, every dashboard tab you have open now switches to the new version by itself, not just the one you clicked Update in.
